defs.def: to put sth into a position so that it covers an opening; to get into this position 关；关闭；闭上

ex.s: In addition, the team set up a separate experiment that suggested that the baby birds that most closely imitated their mom’s voice were rewarded with the most food.
ex.t: 此外，研究团队还设立了一个独立的实验，表明那些模仿母亲声音最像的幼鸟得到了最多的食物。

ex.s: When a plane is leaving in 15 minutes and the door is closing, what else can we suggest but: “Run!
ex.t: 当一架飞机还有15分钟就要起飞、舱门即将关闭时，除了建议"快跑！

ex.s: The authorities closed access to the bridge and tens of thousands of people made their way back to land.
ex.t: 当局关闭了通往桥梁的通道，数万人返回了陆地。

ex.s: It opens/ closes at … There's a… called…It’s… I'd recommend… You can… Listen to student A talking about recycling.
ex.t: 它在……打开/关闭……有一个……叫……这是……我建议……你可以……听听学生A谈论回收。

ex.s: The movie is set in a small town where the only movie theater is preparing to close down.
ex.t: 这部电影设定在一个小镇上，那里唯一的电影院正准备关闭。

ex.s: G.Leave it open when you’re available to talk and close it when you’re not
ex.t: G. 当你有空交谈时把它打开，没空时关上

defs.def: to move the parts of sth together so that it is no longer open 合上；合拢
to make the work of a shop/store, etc. stop for a period of time; to not be open for people to use （使）关门，关闭（一段时间）；不开放

ex.s: The cafe closes at 9 pm every day.
ex.t: 咖啡馆每天晚上9点关门。

ex.s: The café is located upstairs in Building 1 and is open daily until one hour before Pacific Science Center closes.
ex.t: 咖啡厅位于1号楼楼上，每天开放至太平洋科学中心闭馆前一小时。

ex.s: I missed that paragraph because I was thinking of something else, but I’m going to keep on going and start paying close attention.”
ex.t: 我漏看了那一段，因为我在想别的事情，但我会继续读下去，并开始集中注意力。"

ex.s: Open from 11:00 am to 9:45 pm Closed on Tuesday.
ex.t: 营业时间：上午11:00至晚上9:45，周二休息。

ex.s: The bridge was closed to motor traffic so people could enjoy a walk across it.
ex.t: 这座桥禁止机动车通行，这样人们就能享受步行过桥的乐趣。

defs.def: if a company, shop/store, etc. closes, or if you close it, it stops operating as a business 停业；关闭；歇业；倒闭

ex.s: It will close down.
ex.t: 它会倒闭。

ex.s: As an added bonus, it’s close to the main train station.
ex.t: 作为额外的优点，它离主要火车站很近。

ex.s: Hotel and Hostel Des Artistes is located just a 10-minute walk from the central city station and it’s close to all of the city’s main attractions.
ex.t: 艺术家酒店兼青旅距市中心车站仅10分钟步行路程，靠近城市所有主要景点。

ex.s: Baggy wears a pollution monitor on her collar so she can take data measurements close to the ground.
ex.t: 巴吉的衣领上戴着一个污染监测器，这样她就能在贴近地面的地方采集数据。

ex.s: If you are close to the front of the list, you have a good chance of gaining a place in the programme in the near future.
ex.t: 如果你排在名单靠前位置，你很有机会在近期获得该项目的一个名额。

ex.s: You mustn't walk too close to the edge of the hill path.
ex.t: 您不能走得太近山路的边缘。

defs.def: to end or make sth end （使）结束，终止
to be worth a particular amount at the end of the day's business 收盘
to make the distance or difference between two people or things smaller; to become smaller or narrower （使）缩小，接近；变小；变窄

ex.s: be close to nature.
ex.t: 接近大自然。

ex.s: You’ll find yourself virtually alone, or close to it.
ex.t: 你会发现自己几乎独自一人，或者接近如此。

defs.def: to hold sth/sb firmly 把 … 牢牢抱住（或抓住、握住）

ex.s: I stuffed a piece of cloth into the hole and took her outside, closing the door securely behind me.
ex.t: 我把一块布塞进洞里，把她带到外面，随手把门牢牢关上。

defs.def: if a group of people close ranks, they work closely together to defend themselves, especially when they are being criticized （尤指受到批评时）抱团，携手合作

ex.s: And there are questions about the films made outside the States, which sometimes are not monitored as closely as productions filmed in the Sates.
ex.t: 还有一些关于在美国境外拍摄的电影的问题，它们有时不像美国境内制作的作品那样受到严密监控。

ex.s: Amazingly, the trees grow in such a way that their leaves and branches, although close together, never actually touch those of another tree.
ex.t: 令人惊奇的是，这些树的生长方式使得它们的叶子和树枝虽然靠得很近，却从不真正触碰到另一棵树的叶子和树枝。

ex.s: They could not open and close their lips easily.
ex.t: 他们不能轻松地开合嘴唇。

ex.s: People enjoy living close to nature.
ex.t: 人们喜欢住得离自然近一些。

ex.s: He was encouraged by a close neighbour.
ex.t: 他受到了一位亲密邻居的鼓励。

ex.s: The dogs’ responses are under close observation.
ex.t: 狗的反应正在接受密切观察。

ex.s: The idea is that white coats are associated with scientists, who are in turn though to have close attention to detail.
ex.t: 这一观点认为白大褂与科学家联系在一起，而科学家又被认为对细节有着密切的关注。

ex.s: When I was four years old, I sat close to the radio in the living room.
ex.t: 四岁时，我坐在客厅的收音机旁。

defs.def: if soldiers close ranks, they move closer together in order to defend themselves （士兵）成密集队形，相互靠拢
when the days close in, they become gradually shorter during the autumn/fall （秋季白天）逐渐变短
if the weather closes in, it gets worse （天气）变坏
when the night closes in, it gets darker （夜色）加浓；（夜幕）降临
to sell goods very cheaply in order to get rid of them quickly 削价销售；清仓处理；大甩卖
to finish or settle sth 结束；了结
when a wound closes up, it heals （伤口）愈合
to hide your thoughts or emotions 隐瞒，掩饰（思想感情）
to shut and lock sth such as a shop/store or a building, especially for a short period of time （尤指临时）关门停业，锁上门

ex.s: Leave it open when you’re available to talk and close it when you’re not
ex.t: 你可以谈话时开着门，不能谈话时关上门

defs.def: to come closer together; to bring people or things closer together （使）靠拢，靠紧
to become narrower and less open 变狭窄
near in space or time （在空间、时间上）接近
almost in a particular state; likely to do sth soon 几乎（处于某种状态）；可能（快要做某事）
knowing sb very well and liking them very much 亲密的；密切的

ex.s: You write “Hi Nanna and Pop” because you are close to them.
ex.t: 你写"亲爱的爷爷奶奶"是因为你们关系亲密。

ex.s: The Australians have a close relationship with the British.
ex.t: 澳大利亚人与英国人关系密切。

ex.s: The cat would be closely watched.
ex.t: 这只猫会被密切监视。

ex.s: They are close friends.
ex.t: 他们是亲密朋友。

ex.s: They are close friends.
ex.t: 他们是亲密朋友。

defs.def: near in family relationship （家庭关系）亲近的

ex.s: To get people close to nature.
ex.t: 让人们亲近自然。

ex.s: Oliver says if you're   2   (luck) enough to have someone close to you who enjoys cooking, ask them   3   you can join in when it's possible.
ex.t: 奥利弗说，如果你2(幸运)足够有 与你亲近的人谁喜欢做饭，问他们3,你可以加入 当有可能。

ex.s: I felt so closely to him.
ex.t: 我感觉和他非常亲近。

ex.s: She chose the UW-Eau Claire program at Ministry Saint Joseph’s Hospital in Marshfield because she was able to pursue her four-year degree close to home.
ex.t: 她选择了位于马什菲尔德的明斯特圣约瑟夫医院的UW-Eau Claire项目，因为她能在离家近的地方攻读四年制学位。

defs.def: very involved in the work or activities of sb else, usually seeing and talking to them regularly （与某人的工作或活动）紧密相关的，密切的

ex.s: It is closely linked to the steam age.
ex.t: 它与蒸汽时代密切相关。

ex.s: They followed other scientists closely.
ex.t: 他们紧密跟随其他科学家。

ex.s: They were closely connected
ex.t: 它们紧密相连

defs.def: careful and thorough 细致的；严密的；周密的

ex.s: They conducted in-depth and close studies.
ex.t: 他们进行了深入而细致的研究。

defs.def: very similar to sth else or to an amount 酷似的；几乎相等的
won by only a small amount or distance 实力相差无几的；仅以些微之差获胜的
（通常指危险或不愉快的情况几乎发生）差一点儿，险些

ex.s: A workout partner usually needs to live close by.
ex.t: 锻炼伙伴通常需要住在附近。

defs.def: with little or no space in between 空隙极小的；无空隙的；密集的；紧凑的

ex.s: The English youngster noticed that pollution levels are around two-thirds higher close to the ground than they are in the air at the height where they are recorded by the agency.
ex.t: 这位英国少年注意到，靠近地面的污染水平约为地面高度三分之二，而该高度的数据是由该机构记录的。

defs.def: cut very short, near to the skin 剪到齐根的；剪得很短的
carefully guarded 严加戒备的；守卫严密的
warm in an uncomfortable way because there does not seem to be enough fresh air 闷热的；不通风的
not willing to give personal information about yourself （对自己的个人信息）守口如瓶

ex.s: She writes from the practical angle of a business person rather than as an academic, making for a guide which is highly accessible and informative and which, by the close, will make you feel almost as smart as AI.
ex.t: 她从一个商人的实用角度而非学者角度写作，使这本指南极易读又有信息量，读到最后会让你觉得自己几乎和AI一样聪明。

ex.s: I use my photography to make an impact on people, especially when it comes to environmental issues Today I've been photographing a crocodile swimming close to our boat, the Kimberley Quest, all day.
ex.t: 我用自己的摄影影响人们，尤其是在环境问题上。今天我一整天都在拍摄一条游近我们“金伯利探索号”船边的鳄鱼。

defs.def: not liking to spend money 吝啬；小气
produced with the mouth in a relatively closed position 元音

ex.s: Closed on Tuesday.
ex.t: 周二休息。

ex.s: Closed on Sunday and Monday.
ex.t: 周日、周一休息。

ex.s: Closed: 24-26 December and 1 January.
Sunday—Friday (closed on Saturday)11:00 am—4:00pm, 30th March—2nd November.
ex.t: 周日至周五（周六闭馆）上午11:00—下午4:00，3月30日至11月2日。

defs.def: a street that is closed at one end 尤用于街道名称
the grounds and buildings that surround and belong to a cathedral 大教堂所属的周围场地及建筑物

ex.s: Get up close to the monuments and memorials as your bike the sites of Capitol Hill and the National Mall.
ex.t: 当你骑行经过国会山和国家广场的景点时，可以近距离观赏那些纪念碑和纪念建筑。

defs.def: the end or conclusion of sth 结束；终结

ex.s: Still, most of us volunteers breathe a sigh of relief when the season comes to a close.
ex.t: 尽管如此，当我们大多数志愿者在赛季结束时都会松一口气。
